newsitem.title: UK: Med oil products steady to touch firmer.
newsitem.headline: Med oil products steady to touch firmer.

text.p: Med oil products were largely firmer on Friday, traders said.
Gas oil prices remained firm with tight prompt supplies, particularly of diesel but also 0.2 sulphur material and demand into the East Med supportive.
Traders said tenders for early August deliveries in to Turkey and Syria for up to seven cargoes kept sentiment firm while limited local demand balanced the tight prompt market.
Jet was firm with refiners offering only small parcels. Traders said buyers were mainly focused on next month's Libyan programme with the few larger cargoes around highly priced.
They said high freight costs were restrictive and putting together combination cargoes was proving very difficult.
Naphtha dealers saw Med values stable in the high $180s in the absence of fresh buying interest or identifiable offers.
Brokers and petchem end-users, who had expressed surprise about the $190 CIF Med sale of a Greek cargo Thursday, said it was unlikely that by end-Friday at least talk would reach that level.
They did, however, acknowledge that a still open arb window from the Med to the East and to the US Gulf would keep the market tight for several days yet.
High sulphur fuel oil cargoes continued steady to a little stronger after a bunker spec cargo was reported sold out of southern France at high fob +$5.
Traders said the market was awaiting for the results of a tender by Electricidad du Portugal for the purchase of at least one cargo of high sulphur cracked material.
Low sulphur cargoes was largely unchanged with little material seen on offer and one buyer that was looking for 50,000 tonnes of cracked one percent not seen on the market.
A major buyer will continue to buy cargoes under its term contracts soon, after picking up at least 90,000 tonnes in the north earlier this week.

Gasoline was a touch easier losing $1 or so having endured a roller-coast ride over the last couple of days. The hefty upwards swing seen yesterday was knocked away and unleaded premium cargoes were pegged around $195 cif Med.
